subject: Make unit test report each memory leak only once (#2304)
reason: The change only edits Valkey's unit test harness (src/unit/test_main.c, test_hashtable.c, test_rax.c, test_zmalloc.c, test_files.h) so that leak checks compare against a baseline of zmalloc_used_memory() taken before each suite instead of asserting zero, and it removes two now-redundant unit tests. No code in valkey-server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, or the check tools is touched; the unit-test binary is never run by the fuzzer's deployments. There is no runtime behavior to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
